name: gplanchat/grpc-client
description: gRPC unary client over HTTP/2 without ext-grpc: curl or Guzzle, the status read from the trailers

suggest.ext-curl: For CurlGrpcTransport: one HTTP/2 POST per unary call
suggest.guzzlehttp/guzzle: For GuzzleGrpcTransport (7.14 or newer, cURL handler): gRPC over the application's Guzzle client
